title: Enclosure fit with thermal clearance
description: You have a 200x100x60mm enclosure. Place three components (comp_x: 40x40x20mm, comp_y: 40x40x20mm, comp_z: 20x20x10mm) fully inside the enclosure with no overlap. comp_x and comp_y both run hot and must be kept at least 15mm apart (shortest surface-to-surface gap). Return positions as the min-corner [x,y,z] of each box in millimeters.
